name: EU AI Act Article 50 transparency checklist (Kalpa wording)
disclaimer: Our own checklist, not the legal text. Not legal advice and not a certification.

sources.what: In force 2 Aug 2026; Omnibus marking grace period

controls.name: People are told they are talking to an AI system (chatbots, voice agents), unless it is obvious
AI-generated audio, image, video or text is marked in a machine-readable way as AI-generated
evidence: watermark or metadata method per output type

transition.for: generative systems already on the market before 2 Aug 2026

controls.name: People exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation are told it is running
Deep fakes, and AI text published to inform the public, are disclosed as AI-generated or manipulated
evidence: label on published content or 'not used'

controls.name: The disclosure is clear and given at the latest at the first interaction or exposure, and is accessible
evidence: where and when the disclosure shows

controls.name: You know whether you have EU users at all (if none, Art. 50 likely does not reach you)
